name: coordkit
description: Same-machine multi-instance coordination, packaged here as the Claude Code adapter: a per-repo bus + cross-instance ledger that tracks who else is live and which files they touch, and surfaces it. NEVER BLOCKS BY DEFAULT — out of the box these hooks only observe and warn. Now also includes the opt-in hard anti-clobber guard (formerly the coordguard plugin): off unless you run /guard on, and only then can a Write/Edit to a file another instance changed be denied.
